name: wage-ledger
description: Wage and grievance ledger for inter-state migrant workers in Kerala

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server run env:init && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "api,web" --prefix-colors "blue,magenta" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
